theorems.name: Submission.ind_md_ae_closedBall_growth
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)), ν univ < ∞ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)), ∃ C r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) r₀, ν (closedBall x r) < ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)
